records.context: After a local cache miss, spaCR AI (free) asks the relay's ``/diagnose`` with the anonymised summary and :data:`spacr.crashreport.EXPLAIN_QUESTION`; a vendor CLI answers :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` here (:func:`write_report_summary`). The returned text can be used for the console and the report's ``ai_summary``. After a local miss, this function attempts one provider request; a relay reply can itself be cached. Blocks, so call it off the main GUI execution path.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.explain_failure#1
records.source: After a local cache miss, spaCR AI (free) asks the relay's ``/diagnose`` with the anonymised summary and :data:`spacr.crashreport.EXPLAIN_QUESTION`; a vendor CLI answers :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` here (:func:`write_report_summary`). The returned text can be used for the console and the report's ``ai_summary``. After a local miss, this function attempts one provider request; a relay reply can itself be cached. Blocks, so call it off the GUI thread.
records.translation: Efter en lokal cachemiss frågar spaCR AI (gratis) reläets ``/diagnose``-rutt med den anonymiserade sammanfattningen och :data:`spacr.crashreport.EXPLAIN_QUESTION`; en leverantörs-CLI besvarar här :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` (:func:`write_report_summary`). Den returnerade texten kan användas i konsolen och som rapportens ``ai_summary``. Efter en lokal miss försöker funktionen göra en leverantörsbegäran; reläets svar kan i sin tur vara cachat. Blockerar, så anropa utanför GUI-tråden.

records.context: With no provider, return ``"refused": "none"`` without consulting the local cache. Otherwise a valid explanation from :func:`spacr.crashreport.saved_explanation` is reused before any request, for every provider. Cache entries can expire or be evicted, and failed saves are ignored, so the same error can require another request.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.explain_failure#6
records.source: With no provider, return ``"refused": "none"`` without consulting the local cache. Otherwise a valid explanation from :func:`spacr.crashreport.saved_explanation` is reused before any request, for every provider. Cache entries can expire or be evicted, and failed saves are ignored, so the same error can require another request.
records.translation: Utan leverantör returneras ``"refused": "none"`` utan att den lokala cachen läses. Annars återanvänds en giltig förklaring från :func:`spacr.crashreport.saved_explanation` före varje begäran, oavsett leverantör. Cacheposter kan löpa ut eller tas bort för att ge plats åt andra, och misslyckade sparförsök ignoreras, så samma fel kan kräva en ny begäran.

records.context: Only a conversation consisting of a single user message is eligible. A message containing ``Traceback (most recent call last)`` is excluded even when short. The original message, including console context, code and active-app metadata, must fit within :data:`spacr.crashreport.QUESTION_CACHE_CONTEXT_MAX` characters. :func:`spacr.crashreport.question_key` validates and hashes the cleaned question and active app; the structured-data name does not depend on the provider.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.question_cache_key#1
records.source: Only a conversation consisting of a single user message is eligible. A message containing ``Traceback (most recent call last)`` is excluded even when short. The original message, including console context, code and active-app metadata, must fit within :data:`spacr.crashreport.QUESTION_CACHE_CONTEXT_MAX` characters. :func:`spacr.crashreport.question_key` validates and hashes the cleaned question and active app; the key does not depend on the provider.
records.translation: Endast en konversation som består av ett enda användarmeddelande är berättigad. Ett meddelande med ``Traceback (most recent call last)`` utesluts även om det är kort. Det ursprungliga meddelandet, inklusive konsolkontext, kod och metadata för den aktiva appen, måste rymmas inom :data:`spacr.crashreport.QUESTION_CACHE_CONTEXT_MAX` tecken. :func:`spacr.crashreport.question_key` validerar och hashberäknar den rensade frågan och den aktiva appen; nyckeln beror inte på leverantören.

records.translation: Förbered en rapport för att begära eller inkludera en AI-sammanfattning.

records.context: For spaCR AI (free), set ``summarize: true`` so report submission can request a relay-written summary; this function does not contact the relay itself. A vendor CLI writes the summary here (:func:`write_report_summary`) and a non-empty result is included as ``ai_summary``. With no provider, or when the CLI gives no text, the copied report data is unchanged.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.with_ai_summary#1
records.source: For spaCR AI (free), set ``summarize: true`` so report submission can request a relay-written summary; this function does not contact the relay itself. A vendor CLI writes the summary here (:func:`write_report_summary`) and a non-empty result is included as ``ai_summary``. With no provider, or when the CLI gives no text, the copied report data is unchanged.
records.translation: För spaCR AI (gratis) sätts ``summarize: true`` så att rapportinlämningen kan begära en sammanfattning skriven av reläet; funktionen kontaktar inte själv reläet. En leverantörs-CLI skriver sammanfattningen här (:func:`write_report_summary`), och ett icke-tomt resultat inkluderas som ``ai_summary``. Utan leverantör, eller när CLI inte ger någon text, förblir den kopierade rapportdatan oförändrad.

records.context: The provider is given :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` as a single user message, and a background execution unit collects its reply. If the worker is still executing after ``timeout`` seconds, cancellation is requested and ``""`` is returned; a provider exception or an empty reply also gives ``""``. Blocks, so call it off the main GUI execution path.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summary#1
records.source: The provider is given :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` as a single user message, and a worker thread collects its reply. If the worker is still running after ``timeout`` seconds, cancellation is requested and ``""`` is returned; a provider exception or an empty reply also gives ``""``. Blocks, so call it off the GUI thread.
records.translation: Leverantören får :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` som ett enda användarmeddelande, och en arbetstråd samlar in svaret. Om tråden fortfarande körs efter ``timeout`` sekunder begärs avbrott och ``""`` returneras; även ett leverantörsundantag eller ett tomt svar ger ``""``. Blockerar, så anropa utanför GUI-tråden.
